author: claude
summary: Builds the voice-card-consolidation plan's task 001: the new voice detail page shell (VoiceDetailHeader + a generic, reusable ARIA tabs primitive VoiceDetailTabs), replacing VoiceLabPage.tsx's previous always-stacked JSX. Enforces INV-VC-3 (full WAI-ARIA tabs pattern: role=tablist/tab/tabpanel, aria-controls/aria-labelledby pairing, roving tabindex, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End with automatic activation, synced aria-selected, an sr-only/role=status/aria-live=polite announcement on tab change since automatic activation keeps focus on the tablist rather than moving it into the panel) and INV-VC-4 (a persistent build/test status strip in the header, visible regardless of active tab). Tab content itself (SamplesSection/VariantsSection/TestSection/VoiceIconControls, previously rendered directly) is intentionally NOT relocated here -- tabpanels are empty placeholders per this task's explicit out-of-scope note; that relocation is tasks 002-005.

files.change: New generic ARIA tabs primitive. No existing tabs primitive was found under components/ui/ (re-checked, none). Relies on this repo's existing global keyboard-focus-visible ring (theme/base.css button:focus-visible/[tabindex]:focus-visible) rather than inventing a new focus-ring convention -- confirmed no local CSS suppresses it for the new .voice-detail-tabs__tab class.

New header component: avatar/name/edit-metadata/pills/description (relocated unchanged from VoiceLabPage.tsx), primary actions row (Play preview + Set as default -- new, self-contained, mirroring VoiceCatalogCard.tsx/useVoiceManagement.ts's existing patterns; Export bundle/Publish to Hugging Face/Delete voice -- relocated unchanged from the old footer), and a new persistent status strip (INV-VC-4) built from SpeakerProfile.is_ready/is_rebuild_required/preview_url only -- no timestamp is shown since SpeakerProfile has no persisted last-test-timestamp field (checked api/types.ts) and fabricating one was rejected.

Replaced the returned JSX (previously :141-330) with <VoiceDetailHeader> + <VoiceDetailTabs> (4 empty placeholder tabpanels: Overview/Samples/Variants/Test). Added an inline handleSetDefault (POST /api/settings/default-speaker, mirrors hooks/useVoiceManagement.ts) since this page doesn't receive that hook as a prop and this task's scope doesn't add new props. Removed the lazy SamplesSection/VariantsSection/TestSection imports and the VoiceIconControls render (no longer rendered directly -- deferred to tasks 002-005 per the task's explicit out-of-scope note); jobs/testProgress props are kept in VoiceLabPageProps (unread here, renamed to _jobs/_testProgress) so those tasks can wire them without another prop-plumbing pass.

Added .voice-detail-header/__identity/__actions/__delete-btn/__status-strip/__status-item(--muted)/__status-variant/__status-detail/__status-icon--success/--warning and .voice-detail-tabs/__list/__tab(--active)/__panel/__placeholder classes, following this file's existing voice-lab-* BEM-ish convention. No custom :focus-visible rule added -- relies on the existing global button:focus-visible ring.

New test file (8 tests): full ARIA structure assertions, real ArrowRight/ArrowLeft/Home/End fireEvent.keyDown on rendered tab buttons asserting document.activeElement/tabIndex/aria-selected (including wrap-around), click activation, and the aria-live announcement text on tab change.

Removed the now-obsolete SamplesSection/VariantsSection/TestSection mocks and the test asserting their data-testids render (that behavior moved out of scope for this task). Added a test asserting the new tablist/placeholder tab content renders, and a test asserting the status strip stays visible after switching tabs (INV-VC-4). All other existing tests (voice name render, back nav, phase-stepper 'Ready' step, unknown-id redirect, edit-metadata modal, publish modal, mobile pill-row) pass unmodified against the new shell.
